rain/12 38/farmer 12 29 2 Sebastian 12 39 2/skippable/move farmer 0 7 2/faceDirection Sebastian 0/pause 400/speak Sebastian "@？"/pause 500/move farmer 0 2 2/speak Sebastian "嘿。沒想到下雨天會在這裡看到你。"/pause 500/faceDirection Sebastian 2/pause 200/move farmer 1 0 2/move farmer 0 1 3/pause 500/faceDirection farmer 2/pause 1000/playMusic echos/pause 1000/speak Sebastian "看看地平線上那些逼近的烏雲……"/pause 2000/speak Sebastian "希望它們會飄到這邊來。"/faceDirection farmer 3/pause 800/faceDirection farmer 2/pause 1000/speak Sebastian "我喜歡這種天氣，因為它會讓所有人消失……你懂吧？#$b#待在人群中會讓我焦慮。$s"/faceDirection Sebastian 1/pause 400/faceDirection Sebastian 2/pause 400/speak Sebastian "不過和你在一起時不會有那種感覺。$7"/pause 2000/emote Sebastian 28/speak Sebastian "我們都溼透了……"/pause 900/showFrame Sebastian 39/animate Sebastian false false 300 37 38 39/pause 300/playSound cast/pause 280/specificTemporarySprite umbrella/pause 800/speak Sebastian "來……這裡容得下兩個人。$7"/pause 500/faceDirection farmer 3/animate farmer true true 100 6 7/playSound dwop/positionOffset farmer -2 0/pause 100/positionOffset farmer -2 0/pause 100/positionOffset farmer -2 0/pause 100/positionOffset farmer -2 0/pause 100/stopAnimation farmer/pause 800/faceDirection farmer 3/animate farmer true true 100 6 7/playSound dwop/positionOffset farmer -2 0/pause 100/positionOffset farmer -2 0/pause 100/positionOffset farmer -2 0/pause 100/positionOffset farmer -2 0/pause 100/stopAnimation farmer/pause 800/faceDirection farmer 3/animate farmer true true 100 6 7/playSound dwop/positionOffset farmer -2 0/pause 100/positionOffset farmer -2 0/pause 100/positionOffset farmer -2 0/pause 100/positionOffset farmer -2 0/pause 100/stopAnimation farmer/faceDirection farmer 2/pause 3500/end

WizardSong/54 36/Wizard 54 36 0 farmer 50 40 1/addQuest 28/skippable/move farmer 1 0 0/move farmer 0 -4 1/faceDirection Wizard 3 true/move farmer 1 0 1/pause 800/faceDirection Wizard 0/pause 600/emote Wizard 40/pause 500/speak Wizard "啊……@。我一直在等你。"/pause 800/faceDirection Wizard 3/pause 400/faceDirection Wizard 0/pause 400/speak Wizard "我有沒有告訴過你，自己曾經結過婚？"/pause 800/faceDirection Wizard 3 true/pause 50/faceDirection Wizard 2/pause 800/showFrame Wizard 18/pause 800/speak Wizard "我知道，像我這樣的人聽起來很奇怪。但這是真的。"/pause 500/showFrame Wizard 0/pause 800/faceDirection Wizard 3/speak Wizard "我和妻子在一起多年，直到……直到我犯了一個錯誤，把她趕走。"/pause 400/faceDirection Wizard 0/speak Wizard "她的憤怒與嫉妒如此強烈，身體變成綠色，開始飛越鄉間，詛咒沿途的一切……"/pause 1000/speak Wizard "發現這件事後，我封印了通往她家的道路……擔心無辜村民會成為她黑暗魔法的犧牲品。"/move Wizard -1 0 3/speak Wizard "但現在必須解除封印……因為我們分開時，她拿走了我的魔法墨水！#$b#我需要把魔法墨水拿回來！$h#$b#我本來該親自去，但我……我不能再見她。所以才需要你幫忙。"/move Wizard 1 0 0/speak Wizard "要解除這條道路的封印，你需要黑暗護身符。去下水道找科羅布斯談談……他應該知道去哪裡找。"/pause 500/faceDirection Wizard 3/speak Wizard "我全靠你了……只要能取回魔法墨水，我保證會給你豐厚的回報……現在快去！"/pause 500/faceDirection Wizard 2/pause 500/showFrame Wizard 16/pause 500/playSound wand/warp Wizard -3000 -3000/specificTemporarySprite wizardWarp2/faceDirection farmer 2 true/showFrame farmer 94/pause 3000/showFrame farmer 0/specificTemporarySprite witchFlyby/pause 4000/end

distantBanjo/-1000 -1000/farmer 52 24 1 Sam 53 24 0/addConversationTopic samJob2 2/skippable/makeInvisible 52 24/animate Sam false true 400 43 51/viewport -100 -100 true unfreeze/pause 4000/stopAnimation Sam/showFrame Sam 39/pause 400/jump Sam/emote Sam 16/pause 500/speak Sam "嘿，@，聽聽這個！$8"/pause 500/stopAnimation Sam/animate Sam false true 400 43 51/pause 500/speak Sam "「親愛的山姆，我們很高興為你提供祖祖廣播集團電視部門『初級作曲家』一職……」$6#$b#哇！替電視節目創作音樂！太酷了吧？！$h"/pause 500/emote Sam 40/pause 1000/textAboveHead Sam "哦……"/animate Sam false true 400 43 51/pause 1000/speak Sam "哦……等一下……$s#$b#……是給幼兒看的電視節目……「快樂祝尼魔秀」。$s"/emote Sam 28/pause 1000/speak Sam "和我想像的不太一樣……$s"/stopAnimation Sam/showFrame Sam 0/pause 300/faceDirection Sam 3/pause 1000/quickQuestion #就當作職涯的墊腳石……#想想你會讓孩子們多麼開心！#真遺憾……(break)pause 100\speak Sam "嗯……對，我想也可以這麼看。$7"(break)pause 100\speak Sam "我是說……你說得對，總得有人創作兒童音樂。但這可算不上「夢想工作」……$7"(break)pause 100\speak Sam "算了……沒關係。我會像以往一樣，盡力把事情做好。$7"/pause 1000/faceDirection Sam 0/speak Sam "看來我最好開始「像孩子一樣思考」……"/quickQuestion #這對你來說應該很容易……#可以找你弟弟幫忙！(break)animate Sam false true 100 33\shake Sam 4000\pause 500\textAboveHead Sam "嘿！"\faceDirection farmer 2 true\animate farmer false true 200 102 103(break)pause 100\speak Sam "嗯……這主意不差。至少可以把歌曲播給他聽，看看他喜不喜歡。#$b#謝謝你的建議，@。$10"/pause 2000/end dialogue Sam "我會花幾天時間處理這件事。"

communityCenter/94 99/farmer 98 88 2 Jas 95 100 3 Vincent 93 100 1/playMusic communityCenter/skippable/move farmer 0 6 2 true/pause 1000/speak Jas "呃……好臭。$s"/pause 600/jump Vincent/pause 500/faceDirection Vincent 0/pause 500/showFrame Vincent 16/shake Vincent 400/playSound clank/pause 800/shake Vincent 400/playSound clank/pause 800/showFrame Vincent 8/speak Vincent "……$s#$b#為什麼鎖住了？我想探索下水道！$s"/pause 800/faceDirection Jas 0/pause 800/speak Jas "我想岡瑟有鑰匙。"/pause 300/faceDirection Vincent 1/speak Vincent "岡瑟教授？就是經營博物館的那個人？你為什麼覺得他有？$u"/pause 500/faceDirection Jas 3/speak Jas "我有一次看到一把又大、又老、又生鏽的鑰匙從他口袋裡掉出來。#$b#像這樣詭異的下水道門，一定正好要用又大又老又生鏽的鑰匙。$4"/playMusic none/pause 2000/playSound slimeHit/pause 400/playSound slimeHit/pause 400/playSound slimeHit/pause 500/emote Vincent 8 true/emote Jas 8 true/pause 900/faceDirection Vincent 0 true/faceDirection Jas 0 true/pause 1600/playSound shadowpeep/shake Vincent 5000/shake Jas 5000/jump Jas/jump Vincent/faceDirection farmer 3 true/faceDirection Vincent 0 true/faceDirection Jas 0 true/pause 1500/playSound shadowDie/jump Vincent/jump Jas/pause 800/speed Vincent 6/speed Jas 6/advancedMove Jas false 4 0 0 -7 -1 0/advancedMove Vincent false 6 0 0 -8 -1 0/proceedPosition Vincent 98 92/faceDirection farmer 0 true/faceDirection Jas 2 true/faceDirection Vincent 2 true/speak Jas "裡面有東西在動！$u"/shake Jas 4000/shake Vincent 4000/pause 1000/faceDirection farmer 2/pause 1000/move farmer 0 6 3 false/move farmer -4 0 0/pause 800/emote farmer 40/pause 1600/playSound shadowpeep/faceDirection farmer 2 true/jump farmer/showFrame 94/jump Vincent/jump Jas/speed Jas 4/speed Vincent 4/move Jas 0 -6 0 true/move Vincent 0 -6 0 true/pause 1000/globalFade/viewport -1000 -1000/end

ocean/-100 -100/farmer 52 13 2 Alex 53 24 2/showFrame Alex 38/skippable/viewport 53 24 true/pause 2000/speak Alex "*吸鼻子*……$s"/move farmer 0 11 2/pause 1000/showFrame Alex 36/pause 500/showFrame Alex 37/pause 500/speak Alex "哦……@。你看到我在哭了。$s"/pause 500/showFrame Alex 36/pause 1000/showFrame 95/pause 2000/speak Alex "12年前的今天……媽媽去世了。$9"/pause 1000/speak Alex "我仍然清楚記得她……午餐會做鹽漬蘿蔔三明治……也會在後院和我傳格球。$9#$b#她把我照顧得很好……而我當時太小，沒能真正說聲「謝謝」。現在她永遠離開了。$9"/pause 1000/showFrame Alex 38/pause 1000/speak Alex "這是我僅存的紀念品……她的祕密音樂盒。$s"/pause 1000/playSound openBox/showFrame Alex 35/pause 500/playMusic tinymusicbox/pause 10000/specificTemporarySprite JoshMom/pause 20000/playMusic ocean/pause 900/showFrame Alex 37/pause 900/showFrame Alex 36/pause 800/speak Alex "$q -1 null#那麼……@，你現在在想什麼？$9#$r -1 0 event_box1#永遠全力以赴，以此紀念你的母親。#$r -1 0 event_box2#你不該一直沉湎於過去。#$r -1 0 event_box3#如果感到寂寞，我永遠都會陪著你。#$r -1 0 event_box4#振作起來。每個人的生活都很艱難。"/pause 1000/showFrame Alex 36/pause 1000/speak Alex "好了，坐在這裡啜泣也沒有意義……回鎮上吧。$9"/showFrame Alex 0/stopAnimation farmer/move Alex 0 -2 0 true/move farmer 0 -2 0 false/pause 1000/faceDirection Alex 3/pause 800/speak Alex "呃……@？$9"/pause 800/faceDirection farmer 1/pause 500/speak Alex "別告訴任何人我哭了。好嗎？$7"/pause 500/faceDirection farmer 2/animate farmer false true 100 102 103/pause 100/jump Alex/pause 1500/stopAnimation farmer/move farmer 0 -8 0 true/faceDirection Alex 0/emote Alex 16/speak Alex "嘿！$7"/move Alex 0 -8 0 true/globalFade/viewport -1000 -1000/end

breezy/-1000 -1000/farmer 20 93 3 Sam 12 90 2 Lewis 28 78 1/skippable/showFrame Sam 25/move Lewis 0 12 3 true/viewport 22 89 true/specificTemporarySprite samSkate1/null/pause 400/faceDirection farmer 1/showFrame Lewis 24/shake Lewis 8000/jump Lewis/showFrame Sam 35/specificTemporarySprite skateboardFly/jump Sam/pause 1000/speak Lewis "嘿！你以為自己在做什麼？那是私人土地！$4"/textAboveHead Lewis "山姆！"/pause 500/speak Sam "呃……呃……我……對不起，先生。$8"/showFrame Sam 4/emote Lewis 12/showFrame Lewis 12/pause 800/speak Lewis "*嘆氣*……現在的年輕人……有時我真懷疑這座城鎮是不是沒救了。$u"/move farmer 0 -2 1/move farmer 6 0 1/faceDirection Sam 2/pause 500/move Lewis 0 1 3/speak Lewis "@，你看見發生什麼事了。對此有什麼話要說？"/pause 600/question null "#您說得對，先生。山姆應該尊重私人土地。#別怪山姆。他沒有其他地方可以滑！#我不想插手。"/pause 500/splitSpeak Sam "好啊！我再也不玩滑板了。高興了嗎？$a~就是啊！鎮上要是有公園，我就能去那裡滑，大家也都會開心。~哼。好吧。$a"/faceDirection Lewis 2/emote Lewis 12/splitSpeak Lewis "你是在故意找麻煩，山姆。我不反對你在鎮上滑，只要盡量別造成任何破壞！就這麼簡單。~哼。我還以為你比這更成熟，@。$4~山姆，這次我就算了。但我不想再看到你做這種事。"/faceDirection Lewis 3/splitSpeak Lewis "明白嗎？~山姆……抱歉對你大吼。以後只要盡量別破壞東西。明白嗎？~明白嗎？"/faceDirection Sam 1/pause 800/faceDirection Sam 0/emote Sam 28/pause 500/faceDirection Sam 1/speak Sam "是，先生。$7"/pause 600/move Lewis 0 -16 0 true/pause 800/faceDirection Sam 2/pause 800/speak Sam "……不過，你有看到那個花式動作吧？帥呆了。$u"/faceDirection farmer 0/emote farmer 16/pause 800/end

pause 100/speak Sam "大家好。我們來自鵜鶘鎮……呃……樂團叫作「苜蓿樂團」。$8"/speak Sam "$p 20#這首歌講的是耕種、採礦和伐木。|$p 8820#這首歌講的是海中城市。|$p 8821#這首歌講的是火車。|開始吧……$8"/playMusic samBand/pause 1200/pause 1666/animate Sebastian false true 104 42 43 52 53/pause 1666/animate Sam false true 208 20 21/animate Vincent false true 208 20 8 21 8/animate Emily false true 208 16 17/animate Leah false true 208 30 31/animate Elliott false true 208 36 37/animate Maru false true 208 29 30/pause 26000/animate Sam false true 208 22 23/pause 12500/animate Abigail false true 104 49 34 35 48/jump Sam/pause 400/animate Sam false true 208 20 21/pause 17500/stopAnimation Sam/stopAnimation Sebastian/stopAnimation Abigail/pause 800/stopAnimation Vincent/stopAnimation Elliott/stopAnimation Leah/stopAnimation Maru/stopAnimation Emily/speak Emily "$p 78#哇！那些電子音效太迷幻了！$h|嗚呼！真是太棒了！$h"/speak Leah "$p 79#做得好！這是一首新的酒館鄉村經典！|大家做得好！$h"/speak Shane "$p 77#我非常喜歡結尾那段沉重的驟停。|我很喜歡那段貝斯。"/move Sam 1 0 2/speak Sam "謝謝大家！$h#$b#但你們真正該鼓掌的人是@！沒有${his^her}$的幫助，我們一開始根本無法決定要做哪種音樂！"/faceDirection Sam 2/faceDirection Leah 3/faceDirection Penny 1/faceDirection farmer 3/speak Penny "所以你算是樂團的榮譽成員囉？$h"/pause 300/faceDirection Penny 0 true/faceDirection Leah 0/faceDirection farmer 0 true/move Sam -1 0 2/speak Sam "哦！出去時別忘了拿一卷我們的試聽帶……只要10金！"/pause 1000/mail afterSamShow/globalFade/viewport -1000 -1000/pause 4000/speak Sam "進行得很順利！再次謝謝你和我們一起來。$h"/end dialogue Sam "嘿，演出非常成功！再次謝謝你，@。"

desolate/35 11/farmer 35 3 2 Haley 35 11 2/speed Haley 4/skippable/move Haley -2 0 3/pause 300/faceDirection Haley 2/move Haley 4 0 1/pause 300/faceDirection Haley 0/move Haley -2 0 2/emote Haley 28/move farmer 0 5 2/faceDirection Haley 0/emote Haley 16/speak Haley "@！快過來！$s"/move farmer 0 2 2/speak Haley "我的手鍊不見了！來到這裡時明明還戴著……$s#$b#但現在不見了，到處都找不到……$s"/emote farmer 16/faceDirection farmer 3/faceDirection farmer 1/faceDirection farmer 2/emote farmer 8/speak Haley "$q 48 null#我再也找不到一樣的手鍊了……$s#$r 48 -30 Event_beach1#放輕鬆，我再買一條新的給你！#$r 48 50 Event_beach2#我真的很遺憾……"/faceDirection Haley 2/move farmer 1 0 2/move farmer 0 1 3/pause 500/faceDirection farmer 2/pause 600/showFrame Haley 22/pause 500/speak Haley "曾祖母，對不起。我弄丟了您珍貴的手鍊。請原諒我。$s"/playMusic ocean/pause 1000/message "她會不會掉在附近？"/playerControl haleyBeach/globalFade .015/viewport -1000 -1000/warp farmer 36 11/faceDirection farmer 3/positionOffset farmer 0 16/faceDirection Haley 1/pause 500/viewport 35 11 true/pause 800/playMusic sadpiano/speak Haley "那是……？$8"/emote Haley 16/jump Haley/pause 600/speak Haley "你找到了！$h"/showFrame Haley 23/positionOffset Haley 2 0/pause 50/positionOffset Haley 2 0/pause 50/positionOffset Haley 2 0/pause 50/positionOffset Haley 2 0/pause 50/positionOffset Haley 2 1/pause 50/positionOffset Haley 2 1/pause 50/positionOffset Haley 2 1/pause 50/eyes 5 -5000/positionOffset Haley 2 1/pause 50/positionOffset Haley 2 0/pause 50/positionOffset Haley 2 0/pause 50/positionOffset Haley 2 0/pause 50/positionOffset Haley 2 0/pause 50/positionOffset Haley 2 0/pause 50/speak Haley "非常感謝你，@。你是我的救命恩人。"/eyes 1 -5000/pause 3000/speak Haley "我不會忘記你在這裡為我做的事。$l"/end dialogue Haley "我真的欠你一份人情，@。"
